source.limitation: Uploaded source is authoritative text supplied by founder; current excluded institutional GitHub repo not independently inspected

items.title: Cross-Institution Reference Envelope Enforcement
acceptance_summary: missing required field produces explicit failure
unknown required value is preserved as unknown
no source authority is inferred
envelope remains non-canonical

items.title: Stable Identifier & Reference Resolver
acceptance_summary: full native identifier is preserved
matching numeric suffixes never resolve as identity
unavailable ≠ invalid
superseded object remains historically resolvable
last-known state is not relabeled current

items.title: Lifecycle / Publication State Mapping
acceptance_summary: lifecycle values never map automatically to publication values
Published cannot be used as a lifecycle value unless explicitly governed by that institution
unknown mappings are flagged rather than coerced
state-at-use and current state remain distinguishable

items.title: Relationship Predicate Serialization
acceptance_summary: direction is explicit
strongest correct relationship is used
unsupported predicates remain unsupported
no silent coercion to related-to
multiple independently true relationships can coexist

items.title: `evaluates` / `results-in` Subject Profiles
acceptance_summary: subject identity is unambiguous
relationship direction is deterministic
process/reference objects do not become accidental canonical objects

items.title: Controlled Outcome Namespacing
acceptance_summary: same lexical value in different institutions cannot be mistaken for same semantic authority
controlled values retain institutional namespace
unknown outcome values remain explicit

items.title: Failure / Unknown-State Machine Handling
acceptance_summary: UNKNOWN never becomes PASS, VALID, SUPPORTED, TRUSTED, or CURRENT
conflicting metadata cannot silently select a favorable value
unavailable institution does not become institutional failure
retryable and terminal cases are distinguishable

items.title: Navigator Handoff Contract Implementation
acceptance_summary: orchestration never becomes institutional authority
workflow state remains separate from canonical institutional state
every handoff is traceable

items.title: Navigator Retry / Idempotency Controls
acceptance_summary: every attempt has identity/time/result
retry never silently substitutes a newer input version
duplicate institutional action is prevented or explicitly detectable
partial completion remains branch-specific

items.title: Technical Authorization / Institutional Authority Enforcement
acceptance_summary: authenticated technical caller does not gain institutional authority
privileged action carries authority context
unauthorized cross-institution write is rejected
caller identity and resulting institutional object are auditable

items.title: Cross-Institution Write Audit Controls
acceptance_summary: no interface permits another institution to write a substantive conclusion outside the receiving institution's rules
every privileged write is attributable

items.title: Timestamp Normalization Standard
acceptance_summary: timestamp meaning is explicit
timezone/offset is preserved where available
event times are not collapsed into a generic date

items.title: Historical Version / Contract Pinning
acceptance_summary: historical exchange can be reconstructed
later schema/interface versions do not overwrite version-at-use

items.title: Compatibility Declaration Mechanism
acceptance_summary: compatibility is explicit
unknown version ≠ compatible
breaking versions are distinguishable from non-breaking evolution

items.title: Automated Version Negotiation
acceptance_summary: common supported version is selected deterministically
no-overlap returns unsupported-version / upgrade-required
no incompatible exchange proceeds silently

items.title: Beacon Machine Property / Predicate Freeze
acceptance_summary: direct source and contextual references are mechanically distinguishable
re-observation cannot rewrite original observation

items.title: State-Change Propagation Mechanism
acceptance_summary: downstream receives change notice without automatic mutation
receiving institution can classify response as observe/store/refresh/republish/flag/ignore
historical reference remains immutable

items.title: Historical Traceability Envelope
acceptance_summary: reviewer can recover what was referenced, source, version-at-use, state-at-use, time, relationship, provenance, receiving context, later change, downstream response

items.title: External-Source Reference Profile
acceptance_summary: external source remains external
Suite reference remains reference
Suite canonical object exists only through governed institutional creation

items.title: Additional Registry Record-Type Profiles
acceptance_summary: each profile preserves Source Record authority
Record Type remains classification, not ownership

items.title: Broader Attestor Input-Family Production Exercises
acceptance_summary: Eligibility is independently determined
source authority remains external to Attestor
Evaluation Outcome and Trust Statement remain bounded

items.title: Additional External-System Profiles
acceptance_summary: common external-source profile remains the base
specialization does not imply source-authority transfer

items.title: Additional End-to-End Production Lineages
acceptance_summary: each path is independently governed
testing does not create a mandatory universal pipeline
